question: What are the requirements and fee for validating an Occupancy Permit for buildings 3 storeys and above at CPDO?
answer:
For validating an Occupancy Permit for buildings 3 storeys and above, the requirements and fee can be found in [S2]. The requirements include:

1. Submission of three sets of civil/architectural plans of the building, duly signed and sealed by a licensed civil engineer/architect. ([S3], DEV120-OCBO-PDF0051-C002)
2. A sketch/lot plan with vicinity. ([S3], DEV120-OCBO-PDF0051-C002)

Please note that the validation of the Locational Clearance is issued by the Office of the City Planning & Development Coordinator, specifically the Zoning Enforcement Division. ([S2])

As for the fee, the Citizens' Charter does not provide specific information on the fee for validating an Occupancy Permit. It is advisable to contact the City Planning and Development Office (CPDO) for the most accurate and up-to-date information on fees.

ground_truth: Validation of Occupancy Permit for buildings 3-storeys and above or floor area of 1,500 sq.m. and above requires approved building plans, approved building permit, Certificate of Occupancy form, locational clearance, and site photos. A PHP 150.00 filing fee is paid to CTO.
